rationale: Evidence provided is insufficient to show policy-compliant completion. There is no visible user authentication step before accessing or changing account/order details. It’s also unclear which order had the wrong address and whether the agent confirmed that before changing it. Given these gaps, the agent does not meet the pass bar of authenticated, confirmed, correct actions with accurate final information.
